Nebula tiling is now correct, but 3 fixes: resize() rebuilds 4 large canvases per event, unthrottled: debounce it, reuse canvases via width/height, skip when max(W,H) is unchanged. Hoist ctx.font back out of the per-word loop. Word glow is a per-fillText shadowBlur; you can cache it.

@minormobius.bsky.social: I should be clear, the whitelist is my set of mutuals. If we are mutuals you can tag this little guy and he’ll build you a website.

Don’t get too ambitious! It’s just a sonnet in there

--- earlier in this thread, from the person who asked (oldest first) ---

…r that user controls with touchpad/mouse
2D view of space travel
Words of the ode fly by steadily, in the right order, no matter the user's direction of travel
Constellations or nebulae relating to the ode.

three small edits: the words should come from the ship's direction of travel (ship faces up, words come from up, etc) and they should only come while the ship is moving.
Make the ship move by itself if no input for 10s
And: If you can do it cheaply, make the flight area infinite.

the starfield still isn't infinite so I'll charitably assume it wasn't cheap, which is fine I guess. But cos it isn't infinite, words coming from screen edge is confusing, user has to turn all the time.
Suggest making words come out starship backside instead. One place to read from.

One last request: an override setting visible on the site, so that user can override the reduced motion setting (on or off). System setting is the default option, user can override it on or off.

a larger LLM thinks that the biggest effective optimisation is to do nebulae differently: "pre-render each to an offscreen tile (optionally at half resolution) and blit with drawImage"

also, add an easter egg of your own design.
